summary: Tempo-synced stereo delay: stereo, ping-pong or cross-feedback lines, the time free in ms or synced to the song (straight, dotted, triplet), feedback to ±99 % through a high-pass, a low-pass and a tape-style saturator in the loop, a little modulation, ducking by the input, width, mix and output. Time changes glide (small ones bend the pitch, large ones crossfade); the line can't run away at any setting. Zero latency; at Mix 0 % it passes the input bit for bit. Use it for echoes and space in a mix (a send at 100 % wet, or an insert), dub and tape echoes, ping-pong throws, slapback and doubling.
use_for: Tempo-synced or free stereo delay: ping-pong, dub and tape-style echoes.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Stereo: each channel echoes on its own side; Ping-pong: the input (mono) enters the left line and the echoes bounce left, right, left; Cross: each side's echo feeds the other side's line, so a left sound's echoes bounce and a centred one stays centred
parameters.how: Chooses how the echoes travel: each side on its own, bouncing left and right, or crossing from side to side.
parameters.sound: Stereo keeps a wide source wide, Ping-pong throws each echo across the picture, and Cross bounces off-centre sounds while centred ones stay put.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: The delay as a note value of the song's tempo (Feel makes it dotted or triplet); Free: Time in ms
parameters.how: Locks the delay time to a note length of the song tempo, or leaves it free in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Synced echoes sit in the groove of the track; Free lets the repeats drift against it for slapback or loose tape echoes.

parameters.name: Feel
parameters.description: With Sync: the note value straight, dotted (× 1.5) or triplet (× 2/3)
parameters.how: Makes the synced note straight, dotted (one and a half times as long) or a triplet (two thirds as long).
parameters.sound: Dotted echoes give a skipping, rolling pattern and triplets a swung one, while straight ones stay square.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: The delay when Sync is Free, 1 ms – 5 s
parameters.how: Sets the delay from 1 ms to 5 s when Sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Very short times thicken or double the sound, around 100 ms gives slapback, and long times give distinct echoes.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: The right line's time against the left's: −50 % half as long, +100 % twice as long (0: the same)
parameters.how: Makes the right line shorter or longer than the left, from minus 50 % to plus 100 %.
parameters.sound: An offset spreads the repeats into a wide, uneven pattern; zero keeps both sides in step.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: Echoes fed back into the line; negative inverts each repeat. Bounded to ±99 %, and the line saturates softly, so it can't run away
parameters.how: Sets how much of the echo returns into the line, from minus 99 % to plus 99 %; negative values flip each repeat.
parameters.sound: Low values give one or two repeats, high values a long fading trail, and negative values a hollower, more nasal repeat.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.description: High-pass in the loop, 12 dB/oct (Butterworth), −3 dB here: each repeat thinner. At its bottom (20 Hz) it is off
parameters.how: Removes low frequencies from each repeat in the loop, from 20 Hz to 5 kHz.
parameters.sound: Raising it keeps the repeats thin and clear of the bass, so long trails do not build up mud.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.description: Low-pass in the loop, 12 dB/oct (two real poles), −3 dB here: each repeat darker. At its top (20 kHz) it is open
parameters.how: Rolls off high frequencies of each repeat in the loop, from 200 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lowering it makes every repeat darker than the last, like an old tape or analogue echo.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Tape-style saturation of what enters the line: above −Drive dBFS the echoes bend softly towards 6 dB over it (0 dB: clean up to full scale)
parameters.how: Pushes what enters the line into soft saturation by up to 24 dB.
parameters.sound: A little adds warmth and glue to the repeats; a lot makes them crunchy and compressed.

parameters.name: Mod depth
parameters.description: Tape wow: the delay moves this much either way (the right line a quarter cycle on), at most half the delay
parameters.how: Sets how far the delay time wobbles, from 0 to 5 ms.
parameters.sound: Small amounts add a gentle tape-like waver, larger ones a seasick pitch warble on the repeats.

parameters.name: Mod rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the wobble, from 0.05 to 5 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow rates sound like worn tape drifting; faster rates turn into a chorus-like shimmer.

parameters.name: Duck
parameters.description: How far the echoes are turned down while the input plays above Duck threshold (0: off)
parameters.how: Turns the echoes down by up to 40 dB while the input is playing.
parameters.sound: Ducking keeps the echoes out of the way of the dry sound and lets them bloom in the gaps.

parameters.name: Duck threshold
parameters.description: Input level (peak) where ducking reaches its full depth; it fades in over the 12 dB below
parameters.how: Sets the input level, from -60 to 0 dB, at which ducking reaches its full depth.
parameters.sound: A low threshold ducks on quiet playing too; a high one only reacts to loud notes.

parameters.name: Duck release
parameters.description: How fast the echoes come back once the input falls (time constant)
parameters.how: Sets how quickly the echoes return after the input stops, from 20 ms to 2 s.
parameters.sound: Short times bring the echoes back at once, long ones let them swell in slowly after each phrase.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The echoes' side signal × width: 0 % mono echoes, 100 % as they are, 200 % twice as wide
parameters.how: Scales the stereo width of the echoes from 0 to 200 %.
parameters.sound: At 0 % the echoes are mono and focused, and past 100 % they spread wider than the source.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry against wet (a crossfade): 100 % for a send
parameters.how: Blends the dry sound with the echoes from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Use a low value as an insert for subtle depth, or 100 % when the delay sits on a send.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output gain, −12 … +12 dB in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the output gain, from minus 12 to plus 12 dB.
parameters.sound: Use it to match the level of the delay to the track once the settings are right.
